title: Amazon Fire TV 50" 4K smart TV (AFTTIFF43, codename brandenburg; panel AMZ_K24NE5_4K50M600A),
header:
Amazon Fire TV 50" 4K smart TV (AFTTIFF43, codename brandenburg; panel AMZ_K24NE5_4K50M600A),
Fire OS 7.7.1.7 / Android 9 (SDK 28), build PS7717.5741N, MediaTek, armeabi-v7a. US.
Done remotely over Tailscale through a Synology NAS as subnet router (docs/REMOTE.md, option B).

FIRE OS: DEBLOAT ONLY. Home stays com.amazon.tv.launcher/.ui.HomeActivity_vNext (priority 950);
the shared launcher does not apply. Same build line as toshiba-fire-tv-aftha004, and the list
starts from it plus the ad and tracking packages from insignia-ns55f301na25.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/amazon-fire-tv-afttiff43/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/amazon-fire-tv-afttiff43/debloat.txt com.amazon.tv.launcher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Protected (pm disable-user refused with "Cannot disable a protected package"), so left out:
com.fireos.usagestats.proxy, com.amazon.device.crashmanager, com.amazon.device.metrics,
com.amazon.ftvads.deeplinking.

Kept on purpose: Alexa core (com.amazon.vizzini, alexadirectivebrokerservice, alexa.datastore;
the Alexa and Fire TV phone apps control the TV through it, and voice only listens while the mic
button is held), casting (AirPlay com.apple.airplay.amazon.airplay, Miracast com.amazon.cast.sink,
DIAL/whisperplay), OTA updates, Live TV and channel scan, Silk (com.amazon.cloud9) and the website
launcher, account and sync services, Appstore, HDMI inputs (com.mediatek.tvinput), remote and
Bluetooth.

Ships with only YouTube installed (com.amazon.firetv.youtube); the Netflix/Prime/Disney+ tiles are
placeholders that install on first open. The Amazon-hosted hero banner on Home is not affected by
this list; Private DNS (dns.adguard-dns.com) works on this build (private_dns_mode hostname) and
blocks doubleclick.net and amazon-adsystem.com, but not YouTube ads.

adb exec-out screencap -p prints "Init wrapper sys mutex successful" before the PNG data on this
set (docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).
